name: octaweave_update_note
description: Edit a note. ALWAYS pass `base_version` — the version you got from octaweave_get_note. If someone edited in between, the write is rejected with 409 stale_write and the response carries the current note under `current`; merge against that and retry with its version. Omitting base_version is last-write-wins and will silently destroy a human's edit. Only the fields you pass are changed.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

base_version.description: The `version` you read. Required in practice — see the description.

body.description: New markdown body (replaces the whole body).
